description:
## Goal

Publish PR #110 as the semantic-correctness foundation and PR #118 as the recalculator layer in one GitHub stack, with one authority per concept and exact evidence that the combined software performs less repeated compiler work:

```text
main
  -> PR #110 wt/kdt-close
       -> PR #118 fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator
```

## Published stack state

- GitHub stack #120 is initialized, rebased with `--no-trunk`, submitted, and reports the exact order #110 -> #118 with no rebase needed.
- PR #110 remains draft, open, mergeable, and based on `main`; its head and body are unchanged at `c2c723c63afdbda22078bb0a164cb313b8c7dfa8`.
- PR #118 remains draft, open, mergeable, and now targets `wt/kdt-close`; its exact head is the reviewed fz-tfn.30 commit `6786b9168b1c08e7ee433a4d60da7eef1f7f6582`.
- The PR #118 body is rewritten for the combined topology, authorities, current measurements, validation, CI-budget decision, and remaining deletion work. The old 50,901 deep-copy and 5,338 semantic-entry figures are absent.
- Immutable remote backup tags still preserve the original heads: `fz-tfn.30-prestack-pr110-c2c723c63` -> `c2c723c63...` and `fz-tfn.30-prestack-pr118-63e55daa5` -> `63e55daa5...`.
- The published top is exactly fifteen reviewed replay commits in original PR #118 order plus one reviewed fz-tfn.30 integration commit. Author, author date, subject, and position match all fifteen originals.

## Current CI state

Fresh CI for exact top `6786b9168...` is [run 33866875958](https://github.com/jallum/fz/actions/runs/33866875958). Its [lint job](https://github.com/jallum/fz/actions/runs/33866875958/job/101003631833) passed in 35 seconds; its [test job](https://github.com/jallum/fz/actions/runs/33866875958/job/101003631597) is in progress. PR #118 is therefore correctly UNSTABLE while required checks are pending.

Stack submission emitted [run 33866876049](https://github.com/jallum/fz/actions/runs/33866876049) at the same second for the same pull-request event, branch, workflow, and exact head. It was less progressed than the retained run, so its duplicate test job was cancelled as CI-budget protection. One complete fresh run remains mandatory; cancellation is not acceptance evidence.

Do not close this ticket or remove recovery/build state until retained run 33866875958 is fully green.

## Combined model

- World owns authoritative interned semantic facts.
- Each retained root ProductMemo is the sole product authority and stores shared immutable answers.
- One dependency index ignites exact readers from fact/product movement; no root, activation, waiter, or inventory scan returns.
- Monotone cycles converge through ordinary per-key reactive formulas, not private cone/fixpoint solvers.
- Types owns one-denotation/one-Ty identity and one operation-tagged memoized comparison map with typed outcomes. Rendered/canonical strings remain display/report output only; raw interner order is not semantic authority.
- CallableResolution is the sole dependency-tracked callable authority. Construction-member selection alone owns semantic seat/drop/member order; perturbation is stress input only.
- Equal immutable product reproduction retains both its generation and prior canonical allocation.
- Native physical reuse preserves semantic identities and must be replaced, not supplemented, by stable pre-lowering body/content products in fz-tfn.13.
- An unread covariant occurrence never contributes a partial join as a fact; empty-list bindings use ordinary type algebra with no cleaner.

## Measured reductions

- The combined 00420 probe observed 17,840 formerly-deep ProductValue transfers, 13,581 typed RuntimeDemand reads, and 237 packaged-demand transfers: an exact observed lower bound of 31,658 deep copies, now zero. The temporary probe is removed.
- The copied EmissionReadyExecutable aggregate and 237 rebuilds are deleted.
- The combined native corpus is 510 candidates = 474 resolved + 2 known panics + 34 expected fatal paths, with 472 paired successes. It preserves 5,763 semantic entries while removing 55 physical roots, 146 continuations, 201 bodies, and 47,760 native bytes; MakeClosure remains 118.
- Deterministic native-sharing work is 206 passes, 18,569 indexed bodies, 17,769 graph roles, 6,796 graph comparisons, and 6,107 body comparisons. The paired 12,796 -> 12,270 ms sample is corroborative only.
- Settled/missing product reads perform no dependency-map clone. The standing root scanner, settled-presence mode, scheduler introspection, duplicate output-set reconstruction, and duplicate type-comparison map are gone.

## Replay and verification proof

The durable original-to-replay map, exact cold-review staged SHA-256 for every commit, backup refs, per-ticket gates, measurements, DAG decisions, and reproduction commands are in `.agent/measurements/fz-tfn.30-stacked-replay.txt`.

Every replayed ticket and the final integration commit received a fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review before commit. The final fz-tfn.30 staged diff was approved at SHA-256 `0f62d04ac9a3292a3bd61e798bf5303f1da17bea10fdf3c3185d79e7bbab56e0` and committed without amendment as `6786b9168...`.

At the combined replay head, full library passed 1,773 tests with 6 ignored; the serial fixture matrix passed 528 with 3 ignored; all 25 fz2 CLI tests, the ignored native census, causal/lifecycle/ownership gates, all-target/all-feature check, strict clippy, formatting, and diff checks passed. The final one-map integration change additionally passed 137 type tests, 9 canonical-form tests, five exact semantic-order consumers, two-process causal work comparison, documentation tests, check, strict clippy, formatting, and structural history/DAG/residue gates using the isolated worktree target.

## Downstream DAG decisions

- `.30 -> fz-kdt.214 -> fz-kdt.213 -> fz-kdt.165`: one exact typed path-aware InputDemand relation, then one reactive atomic per-function InputDemand fact absorbing the mutual-cycle returned-axis repair, then `callable_identity` as the fourth dimension with the BodyKeying Boolean deleted.
- fz-kdt.4 remains the distinct reactive RuntimeDemand ticket; the two fact families share generic plumbing only, never a cone/solver/bridge.
- fz-tfn.10 through `.12` delete PullSession mirrors, make NativeProgram the sole persistent root product, move macro roots directly to RootBackendProduct, delete backend/native fact-map/revision bridges, and reassess nested handles as owners disappear.
- `fz-tfn.12 -> fz-tfn.13`; `.13` defines stable typed body/content identities before lowering and deletes fz-kdt.163 post-lowering whole-root dedup/index/compare/remap work once replaced.
- New P2 fz-tfn.31 owns one immutable fixture observation bundle and pure named ratchets, preserves non-vacuity/failure attribution/configuration isolation, and pins duplicate three-fixture validation from 6 compiles to 3. Its edge is `.30 -> .31 -> .24`.
- Every unfinished fz-tfn child remains blocked by this ticket directly or transitively until closure.

## Remaining acceptance

1. Retained run 33866875958 must finish with lint and test green; record exact URLs, conclusions, and durations here and in PR #118.
2. Re-verify both draft states, exact remote heads/bases, and stack #120 order after CI.
3. Remove only integration-owned v1/v2 and detached `/private/tmp/fz-tfn30-{kdt45-base-wt,kdt72-base-wt,pr110-base-wt,tfn23-original}` worktrees, outside-repository mapping note, and disposable targets (`/tmp/fz-tfn30-stack-v2-target.MkNvfB`, `/tmp/fz-tfn30-stack-target.PoFDXm`, and v1/v2 worktree targets). Preserve unrelated worktrees and user-owned untracked files.
4. Verify the cleaned state, then close fz-tfn.30 without another repository commit or PR rewrite that retriggers CI.
